extracted.name: Rhubarb & apple crumble
extracted.description: Use up a glut of rhubarb and apples for this simple crumble. Ground ginger adds a nice spice to the topping, but leave it out if you’d prefer
ingredient_lines: 350g apples (Bramley or Granny Smith work well), peeled and cut into 3cm chunks
1 vanilla pod split open or 1 tsp vanilla paste or extract
instruction_lines: Heat the oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Toss the rhubarb, apples, vanilla and sugar together in an ovenproof dish and roast for 10 mins.

Mix the flour and ginger, if using, together in a large bowl. Rub in the butter with your fingertips to create a chunky breadcrumb textured mixture. Stir through the sugar. Sprinkle the crumble topping onto the fruit and cook for a further 30-35 mins or until the topping is lightly golden brown. Serve with ice cream.
